name: KPI
summary: Single headline metric with optional delta.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern and no keyboard: it is a Card with a label, a number and an optional trend, all as text. Nothing is focusable — a KPI that opens a detail view wraps the action around it, it does not become one.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being measured. Sits above the number, in muted text.

props.name: value
props.description: The number itself, already formatted — the component does not format.

props.name: trend
props.description: The change, as a node and not a number: the sign, the unit and the wording belong to the domain, not to a card.

props.name: direction
props.description: Where the number went. Draws the arrow (trend-up, trend-down, minus), colours the trend and puts a word in front of it for screen readers — so the direction never depends on colour alone.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour of the trend. By default up is success, down is danger and flat is neutral; set it when going up is bad (cost, errors). Without direction it paints nothing: colour never travels alone.

props.name: directionLabel
props.description: The word a screen reader hears before the trend. English by default, like every built-in label of the web package; pass it in the language of the page.

props.name: variant
props.description: `plain` drops the card: the number sits inside a card that already exists, instead of a box inside a box.
